content: A fixed threading.Timer(0.3, webbrowser.open) started before uvicorn.run() is a known race condition pattern: if startup takes longer than the delay (slow disk, antivirus scan on Windows, contended CPU) the browser opens to a connection-refused page. The robust pattern hooks the ASGI startup event (or polls uvicorn.Server.started) and opens the browser from there, in a thread so it never blocks the event loop.
